The '''illort''' was a creature native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ichtor 8]]. They were believed to be extinct by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="COG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
